nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Workspace instructions for the packages/app web frontend covering local dev workflow (separate backend and Vite dev servers), SolidJS reactivity guardrails (prefer createStore, never fake createResource shapes), Bolt performance conventions with the ⚡ marker, i18n namespace rules, and browser automation commands.
nodes.languageNotes: Agent instruction file injected as a user message on every LLM call; documents the historical use-filtered-list.tsx createResource regression (commit 016a457) as a hard rule.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Package readme derived from the SolidJS Vite template, documenting available dev/build scripts, Playwright E2E setup with PLAYWRIGHT_* environment variables for pointing at a local opencode backend, and static hosting deployment of the dist folder.

nodes.name: bunfig.toml
nodes.summary: Bun runtime configuration for the package's unit tests: sets the test root to ./src and preloads happydom.ts so bun test runs against a happy-dom DOM shim.

nodes.name: create-effect-simplification-spec.md
nodes.summary: Implementation spec for reducing reactive misuse across packages/app/src (101 createEffect calls in 37 files). Defines an effect taxonomy with replacement rules (createMemo, keyed remounts, event handlers/actions, onMount/onCleanup, kept external bridges), a six-phase implementation plan, nine detailed work items by area, and verification/regression checks.
nodes.languageNotes: Anchors every replacement rule to concrete file:line targets (session.tsx, layout.tsx, file-tabs.tsx, context providers), making it a executable refactor checklist rather than prose guidance.

nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Vite entry HTML shell for the SolidJS web app: declares favicon/manifest/OG metadata, light and dark theme-color meta tags, a synchronous theme preload script, and mounts the app by loading /src/entry.tsx into the #root div.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads oc-theme-preload.js before the module bundle to apply the CSS theme variable before first paint, avoiding a flash of unstyled background.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for @opencode-ai/app, the SolidJS web frontend. Defines Vite dev/build/serve scripts, tsgo -b typechecking, bun unit tests with happydom preload, Playwright E2E scripts, and dependencies on the workspace sdk/ui/core packages plus the SolidJS, TanStack Query, and Shiki ecosystems.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Bun workspace conventions throughout: catalog: references for shared versions, workspace:* for internal packages, and source .ts entry points via the exports map.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript configuration for the app package: strict mode, composite project emitting declarations only into node_modules/.ts-dist, solid-js JSX preserve mode, bundler module resolution, and the @/* path alias mapped to ./src/*.
nodes.languageNotes: composite + emitDeclarationOnly feeds the monorepo's tsgo -b project graph; its incremental .tsbuildinfo cache under node_modules/.ts-dist is a known source of stale typecheck results.
